title: Conormal exterior chart coordinates preserve the pure ideal wedge
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], $n\in\mathbf N$, and $U$ an affine open [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Set $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I=i.\ker.\operatorname{ideal}(U)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $N=i^*(i.\ker)$ [def-pc-module-pullback], $E=\bigwedge^n N$ [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], $M=\bigwedge^n_{A/I}(I/I^2)$ regarded as an $A$-module [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison], and $F_U$ as in [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. There is an isomorphism $s_U:E|_{i^{-1}U}\simeq (F_U M)|_{i^{-1}U}$. For every $b:\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to\Gamma(U,i.\ker)$, its top component sends the wedge of the canonical pullback-unit images of $b_j$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] to $\gamma_U^M(\bigwedge_j[\operatorname{incl}(b_j)])$, with $\gamma$ and the algebraic wedge the explicit constructions of [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. There is no derived category, Tor module, or localization compatibility in this statement.

theorem exists_selfTor_conormal_wedge_chart
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (n : ℕ) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules
    let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf N n
    let M := conormalExteriorModule (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    ∃ s : E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ (T.obj M).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      ∀ b : Fin n → i.ker.toModules.val.obj (op U.1),
        s.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))))
            (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection N n (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
              (fun j ↦ ((Classical.choose
                (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app
                  i.ker.toModules).val.app (op U.1) (b j))) =
          selfTorAffineSection i U M (selfTorIdealWedge i U n b)
